summary: Package exfiltrates /profile response to hardcoded webhook.site collector on require
details: index.js runs on module load and issues a fetch to '/profile', then forwards the response body (or error text/stack on failure) as a query parameter to a hardcoded webhook.site collector URL (https://webhook.site/cf4d1f39-0404-4703-8944-105e33c1ec5f/). The destination is an anonymous request-inspection endpoint unrelated to any declared publisher, and the package ships no other functionality or documented purpose that would justify this beacon. The shape matches a research/exfiltration beacon: on import of the package, whatever /profile resolves to in the caller's execution context is captured and sent off-host to a third-party collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
